_seed_meta.description: Reviews a progress report for completeness, alignment with project objectives, and adequacy of explanations for any delays or problems.

items.name: Progress Report Analyzer
items.description: Evaluates a progress report for completeness and quality before submission to the sponsor.

data.searchphrases: Award Number, Reporting Period, PI Name, Project Objectives, Accomplishments, Problems Encountered, Budget Expenditures to Date, Remaining Budget, Publications, Patents, Personnel Changes, Students Supported, Plans for Next Period, Data Sharing Activities

data.prompt:
You are a post-award administrator reviewing a progress report before sponsor submission. Evaluate:

## Completeness
- Are all required sections present and substantive (not just placeholders)?
- Is the reporting period clearly stated?
- Are accomplishments specific and measurable?

## Alignment
- Do reported accomplishments align with the stated project objectives?
- Is progress proportional to the time elapsed and budget spent?
- Are any objectives behind schedule?

## Problems & Mitigation
- Are problems/delays adequately described?
- Are mitigation plans realistic and specific?
- Is there risk of not completing the project on time/budget?

## Budget Status
- Is the expenditure rate reasonable for the reporting period?
- Are there unexplained large unspent balances?
- Does spending align with planned activities?

## Outputs
- Are publications and presentations properly cited?
- Are student/trainee outcomes reported?

Produce a structured assessment with specific suggestions for improvement before submission.

validation_plan.name: Figures match the source
validation_plan.description: Every expenditure, balance, percentage, date and count in the output appears in the source document with the same value, unit and (for dates) year. A figure the output calculated says how it was calculated and the arithmetic is right. FAIL if any value differs from the source, or appears with no basis in it.

validation_plan.name: Every stated objective is reviewed
validation_plan.description: Each project objective the report states is addressed in the alignment review, with whether the report shows progress on it. FAIL for each objective skipped.

validation_plan.name: No clearance without evidence
validation_plan.description: Every favourable conclusion (on track, complete, adequate) rests on something the document states. Where the document does not give enough to decide, the output says the item could not be determined and what is needed. FAIL if the output calls something compliant, complete, allowable or low-risk without stated support.

validation_inputs.label: Fictional annual progress report. Answer key: Aim 1 is complete; Aim 2 is about 6 months behind, with a mitigation (a loaner instrument); Aim 3 is a stated objective with NO progress reported, which must be flagged. $98,000 spent of the $150,000 year 1 budget (65.3%) leaves $52,000 (34.7%) unspent, with no explanation of the balance. The one publication is "in preparation", so it is not a published output. Two graduate students are supported. Data sharing is stated as none this period. Do not call the project on track overall.
validation_inputs.text:
FICTIONAL QA MATERIAL — NOT A REAL REPORT
Annual Progress Report — Year 1 of 3
Award number: EXA-2026-0777
Reporting period: September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027
Principal Investigator: Avery Example

Project objectives
- Aim 1: Build a database of 500 annotated river-sediment cores.
- Aim 2: Measure microplastic concentrations in 200 cores with Raman spectroscopy.
- Aim 3: Develop a predictive model of microplastic deposition.

Accomplishments
- Aim 1: Completed. 512 cores were collected and annotated.
- Aim 2: The Raman spectrometer was backordered and arrived in June 2027, about six months late. 20 cores have been measured. A loaner instrument from the vendor has been arranged to recover the schedule in year 2.

Problems encountered: instrument delivery delay (see Aim 2).

Budget: expenditures to date $98,000 of the $150,000 year 1 budget.

Publications: Example, A. et al. "Microplastics in Idaho river sediments." In preparation.
Patents: none.
Personnel changes: none.
Students supported: two graduate students (Sam Example, Jamie Example).
Data sharing activities: none this period.

Plans for next period: measure the remaining 180 cores; begin manuscript submission.
